title: Adaptive Turn-Taking for Real-time Multi-Party Voice Agents
title_zh: 面向实时多方语音智能体的自适应轮次接管
abstract_en: Turn-taking in multi-party spoken conversations remains a fundamental challenge for voice-based agents, particularly under dynamic floor competition and varying user expectations. We propose ModeratorLM, a role-playing voice agent that conditions turn-taking behavior on an explicitly assigned role in multi-party settings. The system is built on a speech large language model operating in chunk-wise streaming manner. We further introduce a reasoning-augmented variant that incorporates chain-of-thought reasoning over conversational context and the assigned role. We construct RolePlayConv, a large-scale synthetic dataset of spoken multi-party conversations with diverse assistant roles. Experiments on real-world meeting data and RolePlayConv show improved turn-taking precision by over 40% and recall by more than 70%, while substantially reducing false-positive interruptions compared to non-role-conditioned baselines.
abstract_zh: 多方语音对话中的轮次接管（turn-taking）仍是语音智能体的核心挑战，尤其在发言权动态竞争和用户期望变化的场景下。本文提出 ModeratorLM：一种角色扮演式语音智能体，可根据显式分配的角色，在多方对话中调整其轮次接管行为。该系统基于语音大语言模型，以分块流式方式运行。作者进一步提出增强推理版本，在对话上下文和指定角色之上引入 chain-of-thought reasoning。为支持研究，论文构建了 RolePlayConv：一个大规模合成多方语音对话数据集，覆盖多样化助手角色。在真实会议数据和 RolePlayConv 上的实验表明，相比不使用角色条件的基线方法，该方法将轮次接管 precision 提升超过 40%、recall 提升超过 70%，同时显著减少误打断。
key_points_zh: 提出 ModeratorLM，将显式角色信息作为条件，用于控制多方语音智能体在实时对话中的发言时机。
系统基于 speech large language model，并采用 chunk-wise streaming 机制，面向低延迟实时语音交互。
引入 reasoning-augmented 版本，通过对话上下文与角色约束上的 chain-of-thought reasoning 改善轮次接管判断。
构建 RolePlayConv，大规模合成多方语音对话数据集，包含多种 assistant roles，用于训练与评测。
在真实会议数据和 RolePlayConv 上，相比非角色条件基线，turn-taking precision 提升超过 40%，recall 提升超过 70%，且误打断显著减少。

llm_assessment.comment: A highly relevant realtime voice-agent paper addressing multi-party turn-taking with streaming design, role conditioning, and reusable spoken-conversation data.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一篇高度相关的实时语音智能体论文，针对多人轮转发言提出流式设计、角色条件化和可复用语音对话数据。
